name: Marie Badoux — daughter Claudine Thénot (b. 1781, Romenay)
researcher_question: Was Claudine Thénot, baptised 12 October 1781 at Romenay to Philippe Thénot and Marie Joly, a daughter of Marie Badoux — or of a second wife?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-2.csv row 11, hint-samples.csv row 377, flag adds_daughter, confidence 3). Resolved 2026-09-17: false match, no substitute found. The hinted 1781 Romenay baptism (ark:/61903/1:1:W5XL-MP3Z) names the child's mother as Marie Joly — neither the subject Marie Badoux (married Philippe Thénot 22 Feb 1773) nor Marie Claudine Bourgeois (married him 27 Jun 1780). No record was found giving Marie Badoux a daughter. Encoded as an avoid guard against attaching Claudine Thénot to her, paired with a required negative-conclusion finding. Second opinion: Richard Chesworth.
